mapper.select: select a.id, a.plan_id as planId, a.operation_status as operationStatus, a.approval_stage as approvalStage, a.operator_name as operatorName, a.operation_time as operationTime, a.remark from shebao_payment_plan_audit a where a.plan_id = #{planId} and a.del_flag = '0' order by a.operation_time asc, a.id asc
